[[File:DulokVillageSouth.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Aerial view of the village]]
The '''Dulok Village''' was a [[City/Legends|village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon of]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] inhabited by [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] outcasts during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The village was located in the [[Fersal Hills]], some distance east of [[Endor/Legends|Endor's]] [[Research Outpost]].<ref name="SWG:DV" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a number of intrepid [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] explored the village, and one looted a [[LD-1 target blaster rifle|LD-1 rifle]] from the location, despite the violent objections of the local villagers.<ref name="SWG:RRWMI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Rifle Weapons Mark I}}</ref> Around the same time, a [[Force Adept]] visited the village and collected an ancient [[Force artifact/Legends|Force relic]] for [[Loisya Starkos]].<ref name="SWG:RmR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Replacing my Robe|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dulok Village was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The village was originally inhabited by the Duloks of the [[Pubam]] tribe but,<ref name="SWG:DV" /> for some unknown reason, they were eventually replaced by Dulok outcasts.<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
